notes.b1/j1/B-r1: Huge legible time and mode, drift-free end-time clock, auto phase switch with chime and cue, role=timer and aria-live, keyboard shortcuts; phone layout is a little loose and the confirm() dialog is a minor wart.
notes.b1/j1/C-r1: Warm, polished and accessible with a progress road to the long break, but localStorage restore, auto-advance and the road widget overbuild a simple timer and the source is long.
notes.b1/j1/A-r1: Attractive ring card with tabs and settings, accurate countdown and auto switching, but no screen-reader semantics, a new AudioContext per beep and only Space/R shortcuts.
notes.b1/j1/C-r2: Distinctive terminal look with solid logic, but the ASCII bar, text-only buttons, reset confirmation, auto and sound toggles are overbuilt and the status text is dense on phones.
notes.b1/j1/A-r2: Genuinely simple and tidy ring timer with tabs, but it plays a beep and switches silently with no status, has no skip or timer semantics, and lacks keyboard shortcuts beyond Space.
notes.b1/j1/B-r2: Bold full-bleed colour per phase, huge time, progress bar, accurate timing, clear status, screen-reader timer text, keyboard shortcuts and good phone layout; slightly many options but cohesive.
notes.b1/j2/C-r2: Distinctive terminal-style timer with solid timing and screen-reader support, but the ASCII bar, toggles, durations and two-step reset overbuild it and the small mono text is hard to read at a glance.
notes.b1/j2/A-r2: Clean, compact card with ring, mode tabs and tidy code, but no live region or timer role, only Space as a shortcut, and a tiny paused label.
notes.b1/j2/B-r2: Big bold time on a red mode-coloured screen with tabs, status line, auto-advance, chime and strong ARIA; slightly feature-heavy but very clear and mobile-friendly.
notes.b1/j2/A-r1: Polished dark card with ring and editable durations and compact correct code, but no ARIA or live announcements and the time is smaller than it could be.
notes.b1/j2/C-r1: Warm, readable design with large time and a four-pomodoro roadmap; accessible and accurate, though the roadmap card, checkbox and notes add extra and the checkbox looks unstyled.
notes.b1/j2/B-r1: Big, calm and focused with phase label, dots, status messages, timer role and good shortcuts; phone layout wraps buttons slightly awkwardly but it is the closest to simple and complete.
notes.b1/j3/A-r2: Tidy ring-and-card timer with correct end-time countdown and auto work/break switching, but tiny text, no aria roles or live announcements, and the ring barely visibly moves.
notes.b1/j3/B-r2: Huge legible time with phase colour change, solid timer logic, screen-reader timer and status, keyboard shortcuts and a good phone layout, though auto-advance, chime, notifications and persistence add bulk.
notes.b1/j3/C-r2: Distinctive monospace terminal look with correct logic and live announcements, but the ASCII bar, reset confirmation, text-only toggles and dense status lines make it overbuilt and harder to scan.
notes.b1/j3/B-r1: Focused full-screen timer with giant digits, colour-coded phase, pomodoro dots, timer role, live status and clean end-of-session flow, with only an unused done phase and a confirm dialog as blemishes.
notes.b1/j3/A-r1: Compact dark ring timer that works, but no aria or live regions, skip counts as a finished pomodoro, a new AudioContext is made per beep, and small type hurts phone legibility.
notes.b1/j3/C-r1: Most polished layout with a four-segment road to the long break, large clock, aria-live announcements and phone-friendly sizing, though restore-from-storage and auto-start features make it larger than a simple timer needs.
notes.b2/j1/B-r3: Huge clear clock, drift-free deadline timing, labelled Pause/Resume, live-region and keyboard shortcuts, good phone layout; a bit padded with presets, undo toast and persistence.
notes.b2/j1/C-r3: Bold red full-bleed with big mono clock and mode shown, solid timing and live region, but the phase pills are inert li elements and the confirm-reset and odd skip logic add friction.
notes.b2/j1/A-r3: Compact dark card with ring, working tabs and settings in very little code and accurate deadline timing; no aria-live or timer role and the pause state is only the button label.
notes.b2/j1/C-r4: Warm, polished and accessible with good state messages, but the giant pomodoro count outranks the clock and the page is overbuilt with persistence, settings and a hacked-in inline-styled button.
notes.b2/j1/A-r4: Large ring with clear time, mode tabs and settings, correct deadline timing in tiny readable code; no screen-reader announcements, and skip keeps running into the next phase.
notes.b2/j1/B-r4: Big readable clock and thorough announcements, but the monospaced text-heavy look is plain, reset needs a confirm press even when merely paused, and two reset buttons plus notifications overbuild it.
notes.b2/j2/C-r4: Robust (persistence, live region, drift-free) but overbuilt, and the giant '0' pomodoro count outweighs the timer in the hierarchy.
notes.b2/j2/A-r4: Compact and correct, but the thick ring that barely depletes looks off, and there is no live region for screen readers.
notes.b2/j2/B-r4: Large monospace timer is clear, but it is padded with two reset buttons, confirm steps (paused reset did not reset in the scripted use) and long status prose.
notes.b2/j2/A-r3: Clean dark card with thin ring, tabs and settings; tidy, minimal code, though it has no aria-live and a weaker phone hierarchy than the best.
notes.b2/j2/C-r3: Full-bleed red with a huge timer, a clear mode label, a live region and a sensible reset; strong at-a-glance read and a good phone layout.
notes.b2/j2/B-r3: Polished navy design with a big timer, progress bar, cycle pips, keyboard shortcuts, live region and a clean pause state; slightly more than minimal but well judged.
notes.b2/j3/A-r4: Classic ring timer with tabs, start/reset/skip and editable lengths, accurate end-time countdown and auto phase switch, but tabs lack ARIA and there is no live region or timer role.
notes.b2/j3/B-r4: Huge clear clock with good keyboard and screen-reader support, but overbuilt with two reset buttons, two-press confirms, notifications and verbose status text, and plain styling.
notes.b2/j3/C-r4: Handsome serif card, but the giant pomodoro-count numeral outranks the actual countdown, which sits small below it, and the persistence, settings panel and pips overbuild a simple timer.
notes.b2/j3/B-r3: Full-bleed colour per phase with a huge clock, clear primary Start, progress bar, shortcuts and live announcements; a few extras (presets, undo toast) but still reads as one clear timer.
notes.b2/j3/A-r3: Tiny, tidy ring timer that works with tabs, skip and settings, though it has no ARIA or live region, a thin ring and Reset that also reverts to the current mode only.
notes.b2/j3/C-r3: Bold full-screen red focus view with a giant clock and phase label, role=timer, live announcements, tabs as non-interactive indicators; solid but with extras like reset confirmation and sessionStorage restore.
